pipeline.modality: Wearable medical device delivering alternating electric fields (Tumor Treating Fields)
pipeline.target: Mitotic spindle / dividing tumor cells (anti-mitotic physical mechanism)
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (Zai Lab licensee for Greater China)

indications.indication: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma (ndGBM) — concurrent with radiation + maintenance temozolomide
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 randomized trial of Optune Gio initiated concurrent with chemoradiation and maintenance TMZ vs. maintenance TMZ + Optune; primary endpoint overall survival; n=981; 24-month minimum follow-up after last patient enrolled.
indications.trial_status: Enrollment complete (last patient enrolled 2024); topline data anticipated Q2 2026

indications.indication: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma (ndGBM) — TTFields + temozolomide + pembrolizumab
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 of TTFields + TMZ + pembrolizumab vs. TTFields + TMZ + placebo in newly diagnosed GBM; n=741 planned; primary endpoint overall survival; collaboration with MSD (Merck).
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (enrollment expected to complete by end of 2026)

pipeline.asset: Optune Lua / Optune Mya (NovoTTF-200T / TTFields therapy, 150 kHz)
pipeline.modality: Wearable medical device delivering Tumor Treating Fields at 150 kHz

indications.indication: Brain metastases from NSCLC (1-10 lesions, post-stereotactic radiosurgery) — proposed brand Optune Mya
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 randomized trial of TTFields therapy + best supportive care (BSC) vs. BSC alone after SRS in 1-10 brain metastases from NSCLC; n=298; primary endpoint time to intracranial progression.
indications.trial_status: Completed (final data presented Sep 2025); PMA submitted Dec 2025 under brand Optune Mya, accepted as filed and under FDA substantive review
key_milestones: Final data ASTRO Sep 2025: 28% reduction in intracranial progression risk (HR=0.72, p=0.044)

indications.indication: Metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), first-line — TTFields + pembrolizumab + platinum-based chemo
indications.trial_design: Randomized Phase 3 of TTFields therapy concomitant with pembrolizumab + platinum-based chemotherapy vs. pembrolizumab + platinum chemo as 1L treatment for metastatic NSCLC; n=734 planned; co-primary endpoints OS and PFS; 21-month minimum follow-up.

indications.indication: Metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) — TTFields + pembrolizumab
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 of TTFields (150 kHz) concurrent with pembrolizumab for metastatic NSCLC.

pipeline.modality: Wearable medical device delivering Tumor Treating Fields for torso indications

indications.indication: Metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC), first-line — TTFields + atezolizumab + gemcitabine + nab-paclitaxel
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 evaluating safety and efficacy of TTFields + atezolizumab + gemcitabine + nab-paclitaxel in metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma; n=84; primary endpoint disease control rate; 12-month minimum follow-up; collaboration with Roche.
indications.trial_status: Enrollment complete (2024); topline data anticipated Q1 2026

commercial_product.Optune Gio: FDA approved (2011 monotherapy recurrent GBM; 2015 with TMZ for newly diagnosed GBM); CE-marked. Marketed in US, Germany, France, Japan and other countries for glioblastoma multiforme.
commercial_product.Optune Lua: FDA approved under HDE for malignant pleural mesothelioma (MPM) with chemotherapy; FDA approved (2024) for metastatic NSCLC after platinum failure (LUNAR pivotal trial); CE-marked.
commercial_product.Optune Pax: FDA approved 2026 (PMA pathway) for adult patients with locally advanced pancreatic cancer concurrent with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel (PANOVA-3 pivotal data).
